Treatment plan: Turn on GitHub branch protection requiring 1 approval from someone other than the author before merge/deploy. Retroactively review CHG-1043 and CHG-1051.

Risk: When a serious incident happens, the team responds slowly or inconsistently because the plan is out of date and has never been practiced, and fixes from past incidents aren't finished.
Treatment plan: Update and get CTO approval of the Incident Response Plan. Run a tabletop exercise (scenario: compromised employee account). Track incident corrective actions weekly until closed.

Treatment plan: Require the 21 remaining employees (including the 5 overdue new hires) to complete training; managers follow up weekly. Add training to the day-1 onboarding checklist.
